name: Company Man
source:
A mystery villainous man.

[spoiler]The form Shannon uses to intervene in the world from within the seal Shizuku confined him within 100 years ago.  It is essentially a mass of clothing and bandages animated with immensely powerful and meticulously controlled telekinesis.  Even in this state, he is quite capable of casually summoning multiple EF-5 tornadoes at will.[/spoiler]
